item.title: We rebuilt our browser space game as a native game #Shorts
item.description:
In late September 2026, update 0.1.0 was the first public build of SpaceCorps 2027: our browser space MMO, rebuilt as a native desktop game for Windows, macOS and Linux. This clip shows how it plays now.
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2213580/ Play: https://play.spacecorps.tech/ Discord: https://discord.gg/VjW67tkrTb
#spacegame #indiegame #mmo

item.title: Our first drones flew in a Wingman formation, January 2026 #Shorts
item.description:
Back in January 2026, update 0.0.11 of our browser prototype gave ships their first drones. They flew in a Wingman formation and tightened up as the ship turned. Recorded at the time, against a Seeker.
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2213580/ Play: https://play.spacecorps.tech/ Discord: https://discord.gg/VjW67tkrTb
#spacegame #indiegame #mmo

item.title: The booster panel of our browser prototype, January 2026 #Shorts
item.description:
Back in January 2026, update 0.0.10 of our browser prototype reworked boosters. Each one ran on its own timer, and you could bind your own shortcut to fire it. This clip was recorded at the time.
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2213580/ Play: https://play.spacecorps.tech/ Discord: https://discord.gg/VjW67tkrTb
#spacegame #indiegame #mmo
